annotations.title: Get Exchange Listing Notices (Deficiency, Delisting, Hearing Deadline)

description: A company's Nasdaq / NYSE / NYSE American listing notices read from its SEC filings (8-K Item 3.01 and 6-K): minimum bid price and stockholders' equity deficiency notices, other continued-listing rule notices, Staff Delisting Determinations, Hearings Panel denials and trading suspension notices. It answers questions such as whether a company received a deficiency notice, whether it faces a delisting determination and when its hearing request deadline is. activeDeficiencies are the open ones; deficiencyHistory is everything on record. Each notice has filingDate, noticeType, exchange, ruleCited, the effective deadline with its basis (deadlineBasis: stated in the filing, an accepted plan, an exchange event, or an ESTIMATE), regainedOn when the company reported regaining compliance, and on a Staff Delisting Determination a staffDetermination block: reason, letterDate, hearingRequestDeadline (computed by Signal8 as the letter date plus 7 calendar days under Nasdaq Rule 5815(a)(1); Nasdaq only), hearingStay, hearing ("intended" is only the company's stated intent, "requested" is reported by a filing or release), hearingDate and suspensionDate. A null field means not measured, never no. A notice is not a delisting, and no notice on record is not evidence of compliance.

ticker.description: Company identifier: the current ticker (e.g. "AAPL"), a former ticker of a renamed or delisted company (e.g. "MIGI", now BGDE), or a numeric SEC CIK (e.g. "320193" or "0000320193"). A former ticker or a CIK is answered with a `resolvedFrom` block naming the current symbol.
